evals.name: pre-write-for-task
evals.prompt: I'm about to implement a combat resolver function that rolls initiative and handles backstab. Which coding conventions sections should I check before I start?
evals.expected_output: Uses conventions_lookup.py --for-task with the task description. Returns the top 5-7 most relevant sections. Should surface §17 Combat, §10 Action Vocabulary, §12 ACKS Rules, §14 Dice Conventions, and possibly §53 Tactical Grid. Does NOT read the entire conventions file directly.

evals.name: naming-decision-lookup
evals.prompt: I want to name a new autoload that manages location-cache decay. What's the project's naming convention for autoloads?
evals.expected_output: Uses conventions_lookup.py --section 5 (Autoload Rules) and/or --section 1 (Naming Conventions). Returns the autoload naming convention (PascalCase, truly-global-only). Surfaces relevant constraints (no class_name in autoloads). Does NOT invent a naming convention from training data.

evals.name: drift-detection
evals.prompt: Run a quick health check on coding_conventions.md — any structural drift I should address?
evals.expected_output: Uses conventions_lookup.py --lint. Returns the gap between §52 and §53 (the surgical-fix artifact), any stale [PROVISIONAL] tags, sections without dates where one would be expected. Does NOT try to read the whole file or grep manually.

_notes: Eval 1 tests --for-task — the 'don't know to look for' value prop.
Eval 2 tests targeted section retrieval before naming decisions.
